create_tool_subst: create a ToolSubst to build regex substitution patterns for llvm tool names in test files
resolve_tool_path: resolve a FindTool instance to find an llvm tool path using config params and search directories
build_regex_pattern: build a regex pattern with word boundaries and lookahead assertions for matching tool names
test_unresolved_handling: test ToolSubst unresolved behavior with warn, fatal, break, or ignore modes when tools are missing
review_tool_subst_resolve: review the ToolSubst.resolve method to extract tool names and return substitution tuples
